chunks: Blessed is He, who holds the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them. He alone has knowledge of the Hour, and to Him will you return.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's ownership of the heavens and the earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Tawhid al-Mulk* (Oneness of Sovereignty), affirming that divine authority is not merely political but ontological, extending to the unseen realm of the Hour (*Al-Sa'ah*). It serves as a foundational reminder for believers that all worldly power is transient and subordinate to the ultimate return (*Ilayhi turja'oon*) to the Divine for accountability.
